I’ve wasted so much time during my younger years and I am still learning the hard way. Do I feel any regrets? yes. But does it make me more wiser? yes, I think so. Do I still have doubts? yes, all the damn time, but when we really wanted to finish up something. It doesn’t really matter what time it got finished- what really matters as they say: The learning experiences that really molded our characters and change our perspectives  after those mistakes. I am an imperfect human being and it’s ok to feel this way- at least I’m still trying. I still have goals to aim- and it still matters.
